sources.title: BlockFusion wins approval to reopen bitcoin mine on Frontier Avenue

profile.campus_note: One of 11 buildings OpenStreetMap contributors have mapped under this name in this locality, numbered west to east.
profile.research_note: Session 2026-09-03: local press names the operating entity "Northeast Data LLC" doing business as BlockFusion. All 10 OSM nodes for this name sit within ~250m of each other on the same Frontier Avenue industrial site and resolve to the same address via Nominatim reverse geocode; treated as one multi-building campus, not 10 distinct facilities.

reading.body:
BlockFusion Niagara Falls is a multi-building campus on Frontier Avenue in western New York that was approved to operate in 2026, with ownership verified in September of that year. The facility's published specifications do not include power capacity, IT load, rack count, or annual power consumption. A local news source describes the site's prior use as a bitcoin mine, but the operator's current technical specifications are not published.

New York has 31 mapped data center facilities, but only one published megawatt figure in the state's operator specifications, totaling 3 MW. BlockFusion Niagara Falls ranks second by published capacity in New York, though this ranking reflects the absence of published data from other sites rather than confirmed scale relative to them. Without power specifications from the operator, the campus's position in the state's compute infrastructure cannot be assessed quantitatively.

The campus cannot be evaluated for relevance to AI scaling without published power capacity, power efficiency certifications, cooling specifications, or grid interconnection details. Until the operator publishes these figures, BlockFusion Niagara Falls remains a mapped but unquantified facility.
